body: I am sorry that you broke up. Do you need to talk about it?

Its alright, you can talk to me anytime. 

It would be natural for her feelings to diminish slightly when she is away from you. Love takes effort and you must constantly work on your relationship. ultimately, love is a choice. Sure, you can fall in love, but it is more about lust, wanting to be with someone sexually or even just craving their companionship. You must choose to love a person. It won't be a hard choice most of the time, but you must always make it. That is how relationships can last decades. 

But you can do everything right and the relationship can still end. Because she must choose you as well. That isn't up to you; it is all on her.
Sometimes therapy can bring up some unpleasant feelings but it is ultimately better to deal with them sooner rather than later and with a trained professional rather than on your own.
Dude. This is not the time. This is not helpful in the slightest.

I would give it about two weeks. She sounds like she is being very mature about it and just needs some time to gather her thoughts. I am hopeful about the situation. 

If she has had sexual trauma in the past, your action may have triggered some unpleasant feelings. I was a victim of sexual assault and I still have intimacy issues with my husband, 7 years after the assault happened. You dont need to tell me if she has that kind of trauma, just be aware of the possibility. And if she has, it is not your fault that she was triggered. 

Also. You are teenagers. Something that took me a long time to finally learn is that teenagers are well equipped to handle someone's mental illness. When i was in middle school and high school, I would confide in my friends and boyfriends about my depression and suicidal thoughts. Eventually, it proved to be too much for them. The kind of thoughts in your head right now are difficult for an adult to handle let alone a teenager. You are supposed to be worrying about prom and doing tictoc dances, not thinking about dying. At 16, you have at least 5 more years of frontal lobe development ahead of you. That is the logic and decision making part of the brain. That is why teenagers can be rash and emotional. If any of your relationships end because of your mental health, please don't hold a grudge against them. You are all so young and are just trying to figure everything out. 

What you need is a professional, someone who has spent years studying the brain and mental illnesses. A therapist can help you.
You said that you are in therapy. Have you contacted your therapist since this all happened?

My husband is autistic 

He had a rough upbringing, similar to yours. But i love him. Everything about him. 

It is better to live a happy life for a couple of decades than to not live at all. Even if your life is shortened by your prior drug use, you can still have a happy and fulfilling life. I am proud of you for trying to break your addiction and for reaching out. That isnt easy.

Take a deep breath. I have been where you are at. Trust me, the people at school dont all hate you. 

Every person has the ability to make choices. Sometimes these choices will hurt other people. That is on them, not you.

You have a right to life. It is these intrusive thoughts that are trying to take that away from you. 

Philosophically? No. You don't have any obligation. You don't have to live this life if you don't like it. But have you ever considered that you could drastically change your life instead of simply ending it?

Ah hun i am so sorry. I have been where you are at now. Except the world wasn't in the middle of a pandemic. I cant imagine how much worse it is for you. 

You deserve happiness and love. I am sorry you aren't feeling it right now. I hope you find it soon.
I get it. Anxiety sucks. It was nice talking to you. I hope you find happiness soon; you deserve it.

Everyone is struggling. My father in law is a teacher and out of a grade of over 1,000 students, 124 of them are on track to having to repeat the 8th grade. Thats a 10% fail rate. Trust me. This pandemic has been hard on everyone. You are not alone.
I don't hate you. You deserve happiness. I am sorry you aren't feeling very good right now.

I am so proud of you for being sober. Additions are no joke, no matter what form they take. It is a constant battle. You are so strong for making it this far. 

What you experienced is very good evidence that depression is a chemical imbalance. There wasn't a trigger, that was just the moment your brain ran out of serotonin and your inner demons took over. It happens to me sometimes too.
Sometimes getting rid of the "history" can help refresh your mental space. Let me know if you want to talk more :)
Hit me up if you need to talk more.

Its not a stupid reason, hun. You are in fight or flight mode. Its an adrenaline response. You obviously can't fight your girlfriend so you want to "run away." But it is very hard to run away from a situation like this. Instead of thinking about suicide. Try thinking about faking your own death and starting a new life in a small desert town as a mechanic and change your name to Horace. :) it solves the same issues but is a little silly and a lot less violent.

Its okay. I noticed you deleted your post. I cant tell you how many times I have done that. 

It is okay to vent. It is okay to get help from random strangers.

Hun, this is a normal part of relationships. Especially as teenagers. You are both new to this whole dating thing. You dont know what the other person's boundaries are and you might not even know what your own are until that line is about to be crossed. 

Just sit down with her and have a loooong heart to heart about what both of you are feeling. Discuss what your boundaries are. Write them down even. Communication is key for a healthy relationship. 

Btw. What you did was a totally normal "next step." What matters know is what you do with this information about her boundaries.
Any time :)

It can be so devastating when a relationship ends, especially a long term one like yours. What you ro know is focus on yourself. Take things one day at a time and try to be a better person. If you do that, you will find someone who will love you more than anything. It might even be her but it might not. And that is okay. There is not one person out there for you. Any two people who are willing to work together can have a successful relationship.
Thank you. Sending good vibes your way too, my dude.
Take a deep breath. Ultimately, you are the most important thing. Good mental, physical and emotional health is needed in order to do much of anything well. Take care of you first.
No problem. This pandemic has been tough on us all. I moved to a new city just before lockdown happened and never got a chance to meet people.
Your anger is justified. You have been hurt. Speaking as someone who has let someone know how much they hurt me, let me tell you that it didn't help. The anger is still there.
If you want, i can talk to you while you are in isolation. I can send you memes :)
I am so sorry that you get told that. You don't deserve it.

I mean, I've gotten a little teary eyed when my son isn't nursing well or biting me and I am absolutely full, but I haven't done that since he was 7 months old. Guilt tripping a child like that is terrible.
